integrity: General claim follows from a self-contained algebraic proof; finite-field exhaustive matrix checks are corroboration, and scientific historical comparisons are documented. No independent audit or validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to free class-two nilpotent Lie algebras on \(n\ge4\) generators over fields of characteristic different from \(2\); not claiming the notion, basic existence of proper local derivations, general Lie-closure, or classical Grassmannian geometry. Earlier equivalent descriptions remain a historical possibility.
title: Complete local-derivation spaces of free two-step nilpotent Lie algebras
